property_summary: For any admissible play (exactly TICKET_AMOUNT wei sent from an EOA), the pot is reset to 0 precisely when uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty))) % 2 == 0 and otherwise equals TICKET_AMOUNT; the mutant (mod 3) resets on a different seed set, violating this for seeds where hash%2 != hash%3.
change_summary: Replace '% 2' with '% 3' so the win branch triggers with different probability, changing when the pot is reset.
